mapper.select: select 'roam_poi' as sourceType, p.id as sourceId, p.name as name, p.lat as latitude, p.lng as longitude, p.address as address, p.cover_img as cover, p.type as poiType, (select n.avatar from npc_profile n where n.scope_type = 2 and n.scope_id = p.merchant_id and n.enabled = 1 and n.audit_status = 1 and n.del_flag = '0' order by n.sort asc, n.id asc limit 1) as npcAvatar, (exists (select 1 from roam_poi_found f where f.poi_id = p.id and f.member_id = #{viewerId}) or exists (select 1 from roam_poi_reward_log r where r.poi_id = p.id and r.member_id = #{viewerId} and r.status in (0, 1))) as found, (exists (select 1 from roam_poi_reward_log r where r.poi_id = p.id and r.member_id = #{viewerId} and r.status = 0 and r.coupon_id > 0)) as pendingRedeem from roam_poi p where p.status = 1 and (p.application_type is null or p.application_type = 2 or (p.application_type = 1 and p.audit_status = 1)) and p.lat between #{minLat} and #{maxLat} and p.lng between #{minLng} and #{maxLng} and p.id > #{afterId} order by p.id asc limit #{limit}

select 'activity' as sourceType, id as sourceId, name as name, cast(latitude as decimal(12,7)) as latitude, cast(longitude as decimal(12,7)) as longitude, address_name as address, img_url as cover from cms_activity where status = 1 and publish_status = 1 and del_flag = 0 and cancel_time is null and (topic_id is null or topic_id = 0 or exists ( select 1 from cms_topic live_parent where live_parent.id = cms_activity.topic_id and live_parent.del_flag = 0 and live_parent.status = 1 and live_parent.user_status = 1)) and (club_id is null or club_id = 0 or exists ( select 1 from club active_club where active_club.id = cms_activity.club_id and active_club.del_flag = 0)) and not exists ( select 1 from cms_topic parent_topic left join club parent_club on parent_club.id = parent_topic.club_id and parent_club.del_flag = 0 where parent_topic.id = cms_activity.topic_id and parent_topic.club_id is not null and parent_topic.club_id != 0 and parent_club.id is null) and (club_id is null or club_id = 0) and end_date > now() and latitude is not null and latitude <> '' and longitude is not null and longitude <> '' and latitude regexp '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' and longitude regexp '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' and cast(latitude as decimal(12,7)) between #{minLat} and #{maxLat} and cast(longitude as decimal(12,7)) between #{minLng} and #{maxLng} and id > #{afterId} order by id asc limit #{limit}
